items.title: Here Are Wednesday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Airbnb, Booking Holdings, Credicorp, Dutch Bros, Expedia, Hartford Financial Services, Group, Meritage Homes, Patchex, Yum! Brands, and More
items.summary: As the Federal Reserve prepares to move on rates and oil prices surge past $105, Wednesday's top analyst calls reveal which travel giants, homebuilders, and financial stocks Wall Street is quietly repositioning around before the dust settles.

items.title: This stock is Morgan Stanley’s preferred online travel pick in new sector coverage
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley assumed coverage of online travel agencies (OTAs) Booking Holdings, Airbnb and Expedia, rating them Overweight, Equal-weight, and Underweight, respectively, favoring companies with unique inventory and strong direct traffic as AI reshapes travel search.

items.title: Expedia Shares Fall 2.7% After Morgan Stanley Initiates Coverage at Underweight
items.summary: Expedia Group (NASDAQ:EXPE) shares declined 2. 7% in premarket trading after Morgan Stanley initiated coverage of the online travel company with an Underweight rating and a $235 price target.

items.title: Can Airbnb (ABNB) Turn Its Housing Accelerator Into a Durable Edge on Regulatory Risk?
items.summary: In recent days, Airbnb announced it is committing an initial US$250 million to a new Housing Accelerator program, aiming to unlock up to US$5 billion in affordable and mixed-income housing financing over the next decade, with its first US$6.4 million investment backing 201 affordable units in Austin, Texas. items.title: Airbnb’s $250M housing accelerator program to start in Austin, Texas
items.summary: The short-term rental company is committing the long-term investment toward multifamily housing development and pledged support for local pro-housing policies.

items.title: Airbnb Commits $250M to Housing Construction Fund
items.summary: Airbnb's $250M housing fund will provide gap financing for affordable and mixed-income projects, starting with about 200 Austin units.
